args.title: Re-enable the export button after a failed export
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Clear the busy state in the export's failure path as well as its success path, so a failed export leaves the button usable.

label: bug
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

ExportButton.tsx handles the promise returned by exportReport using only .then(), so if exportReport rejects on a failed export, setBusy(false) is never called and busy stays true forever.
